name: Proxmox_VE_GuestPerformance
description: CPU, memory, network and disk throughput for every QEMU virtual machine and LXC container in a Proxmox VE cluster, collected cluster-wide in a single API call.
technicalNotes:
BatchScript: one /cluster/resources?type=vm call per interval, whether the cluster has 10 guests or 5000.

Instance IDs are the Proxmox resource id (qemu/<vmid>, lxc/<vmid>), which is cluster-unique and unchanged by live migration or HA failover, so instances and their history survive a guest moving between nodes.

DataRateRxMB, DataRateTxMB, DiskReadRateMB and DiskWriteRateMB are declared as derive because Proxmox reports these as counters accumulated since guest start; a minimum of 0 discards the negative delta produced when a guest restarts. The counters are scaled to MB before emission, which is monotonic and so leaves the derive rate correct.

DiskUsedGB and DiskUsagePercent are reported for LXC containers only. QEMU exposes no used-disk figure -- real usage inside a VM requires the guest agent, exactly as VMware requires VMware Tools -- so those datapoints are deliberately left as no-data for VMs rather than reported as zero.

Templates are excluded from discovery: they are never running and would otherwise appear as permanently down instances.

datapoints.name: CPUUsagePercent
datapoints.description: Guest CPU utilisation, percent of its allocated cores.
datapoints.alertBody:
Proxmox guest ##INSTANCE## is using ##VALUE##% of its allocated CPU. Applications in the guest will be slow; it needs more cores, or its workload needs investigating.

This started at ##START##, ##DURATION## ago.

datapoints.name: MemoryCapacityMB
datapoints.description: Memory allocated to the guest, MB (decimal, 10^6 bytes).

datapoints.name: MemoryUsagePercent
datapoints.alertBody:
Proxmox guest ##INSTANCE## is using ##VALUE##% of its allocated memory. Inside the guest this leads to swapping or processes being killed for lack of memory.

This started at ##START##, ##DURATION## ago.

datapoints.name: DiskUsedGB
datapoints.description: Root disk used, GB (decimal, 10^9 bytes). LXC containers only; QEMU reports no used-disk figure.

datapoints.name: DiskUsagePercent
datapoints.description: Root disk utilisation, percent. LXC containers only.
datapoints.alertBody:
The root disk of container ##INSTANCE## is ##VALUE##% full. When it fills, services in the container can no longer write files or logs.

This started at ##START##, ##DURATION## ago.

datapoints.name: DataRateRxMB
datapoints.description: Network MB received per second (decimal, 10^6 bytes).

datapoints.name: DataRateTxMB
datapoints.description: Network MB sent per second (decimal, 10^6 bytes).

datapoints.name: DiskReadRateMB
datapoints.description: MB read from block devices per second (decimal, 10^6 bytes).

datapoints.name: DiskWriteRateMB
datapoints.description: MB written to block devices per second (decimal, 10^6 bytes).

datapoints.name: MemoryHostMB
datapoints.description: The host's view of the guest's memory footprint, MB (decimal, 10^6 bytes). The gap between this and MemoryUsedMB is the balloon at work. Not reported by older Proxmox.
